thread:
Maya (Docs): heads up — i'm starting a draft of the v1 sunset notice + migration runbook. need owners for: banner copy, redirect map, python/js snippet updates, and an example that shows model fallback for embeds.

Jonas (Eng): thx. quick Q — do we want the banner to link to a single migration doc or split by SDK?

Maya (Docs): single canonical migration page, with anchors per SDK + model-swap checklist. keep banner simple: 'v1 API sunset: migration guide ->' then anchor.

Priya (SDK): i can own the python + node examples. will prepare minimal before EOD. will also add a note about header rename (Authorization -> X-Api-Key) that trips folks.

Samir (PM): timeline reminder: public announcement Tue 10/10. we need final PRs merged by Mon 10/9 COB.

Jonas (Eng): i can do the redirect map and CI smoke test that validates example requests still work against v2. putting a draft redirect snippet here: 

```
// redirects.json
{
  "/v1/models":"/v2/models",
  "/v1/embeddings":"/v2/embeddings",
  "/v1/generate":"/v2/generate?compat=true"
}
```

Jonas (Eng): note: the last redirect is intentionally query-augmented to preserve legacy param names.

Maya (Docs): awesome. can you drop that file under docs/static/redirects and link it from the migration page? add a short explanation of behavior.

Priya (SDK): snagged a tiny gotcha: the node streaming callback signature changed. i'll include both old and new examples and a one-line compatibility shim.

Samir (PM): also confirm what telemetry we surface in the announcement: number of active v1 keys, top embed customers, and migration risk level. ops will send counts tomorrow.

- banner copy PR to docs repo
- migration page draft (with anchors for SDKs)
- sdk snippet PRs: python, node, ruby (compat snippets)
- redirect map PR + smoke tests
- announcement draft (marketing + legal review)
- e2e validation script + quick runbook for SRE ops

Jonas (Eng): i'll open the redirect + smoke test PR now: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1987
